data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'lanthaneo', meaning 'to hide' or 'conceal'. In Christian tradition, this name is believed to represent the divine grace bestowed upon individuals, hidden from the world but revealed in their actions. The name Lanae carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lanae usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Lanae belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lanae total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
data.cultural_impact: Lanae is a rare and beautiful name, most commonly found amongst Christian communities, particularly in the Greek Orthodox Church. Although uncommon, it has a rich cultural history and meaning behind it. The name Lanae is derived from the Greek word 'lanthaneo', which means 'to hide' or 'conceal'. In ancient Greek culture, this origin is rooted in the mythological figure of Leto, a goddess who was hidden away during her pregnancy due to a prophecy, and went into labor in a secluded location. This theme of concealing or hiding is still closely associated with Lanae in religious and personal contexts.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Lanae carries a deep spiritual significance. It represents the divine grace bestowed upon individuals, hidden from the world but revealed in their actions. This spiritual interpretation stems from the biblical passage in 1 Corinthians 12:12, which states "Just as a body, though one, has many parts, but all its many parts form one body, so it is with Christ. For we were all baptized by one Spirit into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, slaves or free persons, and we were all given the one Spirit to drink." In this sense, the hiddenness of the name Lanae signifies the inner beauty, strength, and faith that can only be truly understood by those who possess it.
